name: ifixai
description: Independent auditing for AI agents, open source. Claude investigates your agent, authors an iFixAi fixture from its setup, and audits it against the one question other tools skip: is it doing the job it's supposed to do, given your business rules and org structure? Adversarial depth, assurance discipline. Test any provider's model (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Azure, Bedrock, …) as system-under-test and judge, each billed to its own account via a key in your settings.
